newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSBC hits all-time high on active buying.
newsitem.headline: HSBC hits all-time high on active buying.

text.p: Shares of HSBC Holdings Plc surged to hit an all-time high on active buying fuelled by expectation of strong earnings growth, brokers said on Monday.
HSBC shares jumped to a high of HK$191.50 before stablising at HK$189.50, up HK$5.50, at mid-morning. Turnover was 2.15 million shares worth HK$408 million in the first hour.

"Some investment funds are shifting from other blue chips to HSBC ahead of the group's results announcement in early March," said Michael Ng at Sassoon Securities. "People are talking about the target of HK$200 for HSBC," he added.
The group will announce its annual results on March 3.
